 Last Update: 
 November 8, 2026 
 The Sky Bet offer for Man Utd vs Aston Villa gives new customers 50/1 (51.0) on at least one goal being scored. Man United host Aston Villa at Old Trafford on Sunday 8 November, kick-off 4:30pm. If anyone scores, you get your £1 back plus normal-odds winnings in cash, and five £10 bet tokens on top.
 The bet must be exactly £1 on Over 0.5 Goals, placed as a single by 4:30pm on Sunday. The five £10 bet tokens it pays expire 14 days after they are credited.

 How the Sky Bet offer works for Man United vs Aston Villa 
 Contents
 1. How the Sky Bet offer works for Man United vs Aston Villa 
 2. How to claim the offer 
 3. Key terms 
 4. Man United vs Aston Villa preview 
 5. Matchday at Old Trafford 
 The Sky Bet offer needs a bet of exactly £1 on Over 0.5 Goals, which wins if either side scores at least once. Sky Bet then tops the return up to 50/1.
 The return comes in two parts once the bet settles. Your winnings at the normal price are paid in cash. The rest arrives as five £10 bet tokens, worth £50.
 The tokens only work on Football BuildABets, where you combine several outcomes from one match into a single bet. They cannot be withdrawn or used with another offer, and a winning token pays out without the £10 stake.
 If the match ends 0-0, Sky Bet credits one £10 free bet within 72 hours of the bet settling. More on the site is in our Sky Bet review .
 How to claim the offer 
 To get the offer of 50/1 for a goal to be scored in the Man Utd vs Aston Villa game, follow these steps:
 Join Sky Bet as a new customer aged 18 or over.
 Deposit at least £5, using any method except Neteller or Skrill.
 Bet exactly £1 as a single on Over 0.5 Goals in Man United vs Aston Villa.
 Place it between 9am on Thursday 5 November and 4:30pm on Sunday 8 November.
 Get five £10 bet tokens for Football BuildABets once the bet settles as a winner.
 Use the tokens within 14 days of them landing in your account.
 Sky Bet's offer page for Man Utd vs Aston Villa 
 Key terms 
 These are the main terms Sky Bet sets for the offer:
 New customers aged 18 and over only. Anyone who has ever had a Sky Bet, Sky Vegas, Sky Casino, Sky Bingo or Sky Poker account does not qualify.
 Deposit at least £5. Deposits made with Neteller or Skrill do not count.
 Your first bet must be exactly £1, as a single, on Over 0.5 Goals in Man Utd vs Aston Villa.
 The offer runs from 9am on Thursday 5 November until kick-off at 4:30pm on Sunday 8 November.
 If a goal is scored, you get your winnings at the normal odds in cash, plus five £10 bet tokens.
 If the match ends 0-0, you get one £10 free bet within 72 hours of the bet settling.
 The tokens can only be used on football BuildABets and cannot be combined with any other offer.
 The tokens expire 14 days after they are credited, cannot be withdrawn, and their stake is not included in any returns.
 The offer can only be claimed once per customer. Self-excluded or restricted accounts may not be eligible.
 Man United vs Aston Villa preview 
 Man United are 17th in the Premier League with seven points from nine games. Aston Villa are 10th with 12 points. The Red Devils have won one of their last five, 3-2 at home to Roma on Tuesday 3 November. Aston Villa lost 3-0 at Barcelona the same night.
 Man United are without Lisandro Martinez, who is suspended after his red card against Chelsea. Manuel Ugarte (knee), Carlos Baleba (hamstring), Marcus Rashford (hip), Luke Shaw and Benjamin Sesko (shin) are also out, while Patrick Dorgu (hamstring) is back in training and a doubt.
 The Villans are without Amadou Onana (cruciate ligament tear), with Matteo Ruggeri and Aaron Wan-Bissaka both out with hamstring injuries. Man United won the last meeting 3-1 in March.
 Matchday at Old Trafford 
 Kick-off is 4:30pm on Sunday 8 November, live on Sky Sports Premier League and Sky Sports Main Event, plus NOW and the Sky Sports app. Aston Villa fans sit in the corner between the Sir Bobby Charlton Stand and the East Stand, where roughly 3,000 fit for league games.
 The away end has 2,500 safe standing spaces, and its turnstiles open two hours before kick-off. Bags bigger than 20cm x 15cm x 5cm go into storage for £5. Our Old Trafford guide covers the rest of the away day.
